correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the full proof over F_2. B is N-by-E unsigned incidence, G is connected, im B=even-parity W, ker B^T=<1_N>, and 1_N∈W since N is even. Thus rank F=N−2. For y∈W, Qy is part-constant with coordinates s_i of total parity zero, so Q(W) dimension r−1; quotient by ker B^T loses one dimension iff r is even, giving rank F²=c. Even class sizes force Q(Q(W))=0 and F³=0. Jordan rank differences give multiplicities and kernel-size counts. Direct adjacency verifier rechecked 164 profiles/492 rank equalities and 12,816 exhaustively simulated configurations. No inference from finite sampling to all sizes is used.

value.rationale: The natural edge-neighbor XOR system on an infinite even-multipartite family exhibits a sharp two-versus-three-step transition, full Jordan decomposition on edge space of arbitrarily growing size, and an exact part-count-only last-step probability with alternating parity plateaus. This connects vertex incidence, line-graph iteration and extinction distributions; the nontrivial part-count parity loss is meaningful independent of computational enumeration. It is an explicit infinite-family classification rather than an arbitrary numerical table or a bound improvement.
